extraction.Name: Hattie Swallow
extraction.Refused/Protested: did not want her patent in fee to her 320 acre allotment at the time it was issued, but she was told that, if she did not take it, taxes would be assessed against it, it would at last be sold for taxes; that the patent was mailed to her, and she accepted it
extraction.Sold/Mortgaged: in 1919, she sold one quarter of her allotment to J. C. Snyder, of Martin, South Dakota, for $2400.00; then, in 1922, being behind in taxes on her remaining quarter, she mortgaged it to The Iphwick Loan Company, for $600.00, then being unable to pay off this mortgage, or the interest on the first payment even, she sold it to William Anderson, of Martin, South Dakota
extraction.Buyer: J. C. Snyder, of Martin, South Dakota, for $2400.00 (one quarter); William Anderson, of Martin, South Dakota — he paying off the mortgage, back taxes, and gave her $600.00 in cash and a car, valued at $800.00, for her remaining interest in the place
extraction.Tax burden forced sale/Mortgage: being behind in taxes on her remaining quarter, she mortgaged it to The Iphwick Loan Company, for $600.00, then being unable to pay off this mortgage, or the interest on the first payment even, she sold it to William Anderson
extraction.Occupation/Income: she sews and does domestic work for other people for her living, which is her only income
extraction.NOTES: Mentally competent; health is poor since about a year ago, when she underwent a serious operation; has been supporting herself for the last nine years, having been separated from her husband; has one adopted child to support, who apparently has good health but comes of tubercular parents; has never received any help from the County, State nor the United States Government; allotment was 320 acres; document number F No. 2161; sworn December 6, 1928; County of Shannon, State of South Dakota | ORIGINAL_TRIBE_VALUE: "Shannon County, South Dakota (Pine Ridge area)" (normalized 2026-04-28 to canonical 'Pine Ridge')
